proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_hit_expiry
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item surface can encode the rarity-scaled passive bonuses, but it cannot encode that a specific piece of ammunition stops being magical after it hits while not necessarily being destroyed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: “Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.”

notes: The rarity-scaled passive bonus traces cleanly as a variant-based magic item. The only omitted rule is the per-piece lifecycle rider that the ammunition stops being magical after it hits a target.
